mullvad-vpn.description:
Mullvad VPN is an open-source VPN application designed to protect your online privacy through encrypted internet connections. Developed by Mullvad VPN AB, it uses the WireGuard protocol and offers straightforward controls for connecting to VPN servers around the world.

Choose server locations, enable automatic connections, and protect against accidental traffic leaks. Advanced privacy features include quantum-resistant tunnels, WireGuard multihop, DAITA traffic-analysis defenses, split tunneling, customizable DNS settings, and DNS-based blockers for advertisements, trackers, and malicious domains.

Additional anti-censorship options, including Shadowsocks, QUIC, and other obfuscation techniques, can help establish connections on restrictive networks. The app also supports custom location lists, local network sharing, and device management.

Mullvad follows a no-activity-logging policy, publishes its source code, and commissions independent security assessments. An account is identified by a randomly generated number rather than requiring an email address.

A paid Mullvad VPN subscription is required for VPN access. The Android app supports Android 9.0 and newer, and some advanced privacy features can increase latency or battery consumption.
